honors.title: Most Mad Hack - Robotic Bartender
honors.description: Created a robotic bartender that uses a mobile app to order drinks and pours them automatically. With the help of an Arduino, Ionic framework, servo motors and other hardware, my 2 teammates and I were able to develop a system to automate bartending. A mobile app built with Ionic framework sends data to a Node.js server. The server then signals the Arduino to rotate corresponding motors. The motors are attached to bottles which each contain different drinks. The Arduino reads the scale to pour the perfect serving from each bottle.
honors.issuer: Issued by MadHacks UW-Madison Hackathon · Apr 2015
